reason: The cited code validates a caller-supplied path and reads file contents via headFile, tailFile, or readFileContent, which uses fs.readFile, then returns that content. This supports SECRET because it can bring host filesystem contents into the agent context. There is no arbitrary code execution shown, and no sending of data to an attacker-readable external destination, only returning the tool result. The lines do not establish that the file contents are attacker-controllable; they could be, but that depends on what files are accessible and who controls them.
